lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Dense cluster of high-luminance circular pixel maxima posterior to the gills, transitioning into a wider, semi-rectangular grid arrangement towards the mid-flank where blob diameter increases and spatial frequency decreases.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity/shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A moderate density of high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, appearing most concentrated near the anterior base of the fin structure.
